title: Scottsdale Luxury Villa Pool, Hot Tub, & Games
description:
Updated 6 bedroom house with a backyard that rivals luxury resorts.

The large fenced in backyard offers unbelievable entertainment.

Enjoy splashing in the HUGE pool. The diving platform, custom slide, grotto, Baja shelf, and large spa allow you to choose a high-energy activity or calm and peaceful relaxation. Play putt-putt, tetherball, cornhole, or connect four.

The rooftop deck provides views that will take your breath away! Watch one of the best sunsets you will see in your lifetime.

 The space 
Luxury Scottsdale Villa – Your Ultimate Retreat

Escape to this stunning 6-bedroom villa in the heart of Scottsdale, perfect for families, groups, or special celebrations.

Highlights:
6 Spacious Bedrooms: 5 king beds with 55" TVs, a bunk room for kids, and private bathrooms in every bedroom. Two bedrooms are in a separate Casita for extra privacy.
Backyard Oasis: Sparkling pool, hot tub, lush landscaping, and outdoor games for fun and relaxation.
Gourmet Kitchen & Dining: Fully equipped kitchen with top-of-the-line appliances, perfect for family meals or entertaining.
Entertainment for All: Game room with foosball, TVs, and cozy living spaces for movie nights.
Outdoor Grill: Ideal for cooking under the stars.
Additional amenities include Pack & Play for little ones and parking for up to 4 cars. Located minutes from Scottsdale dining, shopping, and attractions.

MAIN House bed/bath configuration
Bedroom 1 With a full bath: 2 bunk beds
Bedroom 2 with a full bath: 1 king bed
bedroom 3 and 4 with a jack&jill/sharing bath; both with king sized bed
Half bathroom - Powder Room located in Bar area

Casita bed/bath configuration
Bedroom 5 With a full bath: 1 King bed
Bedroom 6 With a full bath: 1 King bed

We’ve got your back! If you need anything during your stay, just let us know, and we'll be happy to assist you.
With so much to offer, this villa is the ideal spot for your next getaway. Book now and experience the luxury, comfort, and convenience that await you!

TPT #: 21392534
Scottsdale License #: 2023745

 Guest access 
🔑Enjoy easy, fast, and hassle-free self check-in! After completing a simple electronic signature, you’ll receive your check-in instruction. Simply follow the steps provided for seamless entry.

⏰ For Early Check-in and Late Check-out Request;
Please reach out to check for availability and approval. We require all properties pre-inspected after housekeeping before check-in. If you arrive before the inspection is completed, please let us know if you’d prefer the inspector to leave upon your arrival or if you’d like to request that they vacate.

⏰ Late Check-Out Without Approval;
There is a $50 late checkout fee if you are at the property more than 30 minutes after the 10AM standard checkout time.

 Other things to note 
Property Highlights:
Safety First: Security cameras monitor the front door and driveway; no cameras inside for your privacy.
Noise Monitoring: Exterior decibel monitors ensure a peaceful environment—no sound is recorded.

Important Policies:
City Ordinances: All Scottsdale laws must be followed during your stay.
Quiet hours: 10PM-7AM
Maintenance: Landscaping and pool service 1–2 times/week; exact timing cannot be guaranteed.
No smoking indoors ($1,000 fee if violated)
No parties/events (Strictly enforced)

Pet & Storage Policy:
Pets are not allowed ($1,000 fee if violated).
Certain cabinets are locked for owner supplies; tampering results in a $1,000 fee. If you find that any consumables or essentials are missing or need replenishment, please message us right away and we will be happy to assist.

Pool Heating: Heated pool available at $300/day (please note the minimum requirement is for the full stay)
The pool is heated to 88°F, but in cooler weather (below 65°F) it typically stays around 80–82°F. It’s a heated pool—not a hot tub—so it may feel refreshing rather than warm.
Do not touch pool equipment or remove the pool vacuum ($500 minimum fee for damage).
